blocks.text: The BLACK+DECKER BDCDD12PK 12V MAX Drill Project Kit features a powerful compact 12V MAX lithium drill/driver and 59 hand tools and accessories most commonly used for DIY projects and household tasks;this home tool kit can help you tackle projects big and small. The 12V MAX Lithium drill is 35% more compact than previous GCO1200C NiCad drill/driver.The drill/driver features a mid handle design for comfort and control, along with an LED light to illuminate work surfaces. The lithium ion battery is always ready, and holds a charge up to 18 months. This kit also includes a convenient bag or portability and storage. What's included: 12V MAX Drill/Driver, Tool Bag, Hammer, Tape Measure, Adjustable Wrench, Slip Joint Pliers, Ratcheting Screwdriver, Phillips Screwdriver, Slot Screwdriver, Utility Knife, Assorted Nut Drivers, Assorted Screwdriving Bits, Assorted Drill Bits,Level.
